title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 408) reviews: Court nullifies NDC registration

content.rendered:
A Federal High Court in Lokoja has nullified the registration of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), ruling that the earlier judgment which recognised the party was legally flawed because all relevant parties were not properly represented during the proceedings.

The decision has reset the legal process rather than ending it, leaving the party’s official status unresolved and renewing discussions about due process, political party registration, and the legal framework ahead of future elections.

excerpt.rendered: A Federal High Court nullified the NDC registration, citing legal flaws. This decision reopens debate on party registration and due process in Nigeria.
